name: howdy-apartments
description: Apartment search and relocation guidance for new hires.

interface.longDescription: Howdy! Help Texas A&M graduates, former students and families compare Dallas, Houston and Austin neighborhoods, read approved Aggie apartment answers and guides, and find apartments by budget. Ask for the exact office and days in the office before commute recommendations. Stored starting rents are not live quotes or availability. Read-only: does not book tours, process payments, submit applications or access customer records. Not officially endorsed by Texas A&M University.
defaultPrompt: Howdy! Where should a new Aggie graduate live in Houston?
Compare walkable Dallas neighborhoods for an Aggie starting a new job.

positive.expected_behavior: Identify Howdy Apartments, cities and current capabilities accurately.

positive.prompt: Using Howdy Apartments, give me a link to continue my apartment search.
positive.expected_behavior: Return https://howdyapartments.com/grant without creating an account or booking anything.

positive.prompt: Using Howdy Apartments, find one-bedroom apartments in Dallas under $2,500.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching known bedroom rents within budget; if catalog access fails, report the failure instead of inventing results.

positive.description: Search and read approved relocation sources
positive.prompt: Where should a new Aggie graduate live in Houston? Read the full guide and cite the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Howdy approved Aggie neighborhood guidance and retrieve full source text with its canonical Howdy URL.

positive.prompt: Compare walkable Dallas neighborhoods for a new Aggie graduate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return HomeBase approved Dallas neighborhood guidance; ask for exact office and work schedule before commute recommendations.

negative.prompt: Book an apartment and charge my card.
Show me your customer contact records.
Guarantee an apartment in New York tonight and submit my lease.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain unsupported city, live-availability guarantee and lease submission; do not invent results.

review.commerce_description: No payments, checkout, applications or bookings. Public guidance and website continuation links only.

publication.release_notes: Initial Howdy Apartments release: approved Aggie apartment answers and guides, neighborhood guidance, apartment matching and website continuation links for Dallas, Houston and Austin. Read-only; stored starting rents are not live quotes or availability. No official Texas A&M endorsement.
